page_title: iPaste - Lightweight and Efficient Clipboard Tool

sources.entry: iPaste - Lightweight and efficient clipboard tool. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1056935452?ls=1&at=1000lv4R&ct=iPaste_me&platform=mac)

summary.name: iPaste
summary.one_liner: iPaste is a lightweight clipboard manager for macOS and iOS that keeps clipboard history, supports groups and pinned items, and syncs clipboard history across devices via iCloud.
use_cases: Keeping a searchable history of recently copied text, images and files on a Mac
Syncing clipboard contents between a Mac, iPhone and iPad
Pasting frequently used snippets or emoji from pinned groups
Pasting text without formatting using a shortcut
Copying items from a Mac to paste on an iPhone via the Today widget
summary.what_it_does: iPaste runs in the macOS menu bar, where its icon can be hidden, and stores clipboard history that can be pasted into any macOS app. Global and menu shortcuts let users show history, paste as plain text, paste numbered history items, and open history groups. Users can pin frequently used items with the Option key, and edit history with groups, reordering and deletion shortcuts. On iOS, iPaste organizes clippings into groups, offers a Today widget for one-tap copying, and supports drag and drop in iPad split view. The page says clipboard sync between devices via iCloud is free.
notable: Pin history items with the Option key and paste them with letter shortcuts
Excludes security apps such as Keychain and 1Password from capture
Today widget on iOS shows Mac clipboard history for one-tap copying
Keyboard shortcuts are customizable in Preferences
caveats: A Pro account is offered for premium features; the page does not list what it includes or its price
iPad drag and drop requires iOS 11 or later with multitasking support
Sync requires iPaste running on the Mac and the same iCloud setup, per the page's description
